title: A Sales By Customer filter from before the release keeps its options
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Before the release was installed, you bookmarked Sales By Customer with only one Product Type option selected.
    For example: only the parts option selected.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and the bookmark is ready in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • The browser window is a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, and the design picture "sbc-00-b-sbc-filter.png" (board 5.0) attached to this case is open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the bookmarked Sales By Customer link.
  2. Open the Sales Type filter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report opens with the same choice applied.
  • Step 2: the same option is selected under its new name (for example only "Part Sales"), and the filter reads "Sales Type: Part Sales".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S8-E1, S8-R8, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 5.0 Before: "Product Type" ("Before" boards: production today, attached for comparison). Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Report filters are kept in the page link today, not saved per user; whether S8-E1 means a bookmarked link is a question for the product owner.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-E1: “A Sales By Customer filter choice remembered from before the release opens with the same options selected, under the new names.”
  • S8-R8: “With both options selected, the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales". With one, it reads that option's name, for example "Sales Type: Part Sales". With none, it reads "Sales Type: No sales".”
  • Design — board 5.0 title: “5.0 Before: "Product Type"”
  • Design — board 5.0 note: “Production today: "Product Type: All products", options Part Sales and Service Sales.”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs data and a report captured before the release is installed on the test site
